title: Daily Recap — Wednesday Oct 21, 2026
html:
Links: SPY · Watchlist · Fed Tracker · Federal Reserve

1. Bottom line

SPY rose 0.53% to 773.09, taking back its 20-day average (770.88) and closing about 1.1% below its record of 781.62 from Oct 6. Tech led the way: SpaceX's first profit as a public company and an upbeat Super Micro outlook eased worries about AI spending, and chip stocks pushed the Nasdaq up 1%. Two things held gains back: the 10-year yield rose to about 5.15%, and Brent jumped near $110 after a Houthi drone attack on a Saudi oilfield.

4. Setups flashing (to study / paper-trade, not buy signals)

  • Uptrend + RSI < 40 (your tested edge): no ticker qualifies tonight. Two are close: SMH (RSI 40.3, back above its 61.8% Fib at 555.52) and MU (RSI 40.5, sitting between its 61.8% at 879.40 and its 50% at 923.15). Both are in uptrends, with price and the 50-day above the 200-day, so one more soft day could trigger the signal.
  • Clean Fib reclaims today: QQQ closed back above its 38.2% level (723.74). NVDA closed back above its 50% level (216.58), with the 38.2% level at 222.91 just overhead. DELL bounced 5% off its 50% level (479.18), but it is still below its 20- and 50-day averages. Momentum names like DELL have not rewarded dip-buying in your tests, so wait for it to retake the 50-day (513.58) before treating this as a setup.
  • SPY: the key short-term line is 768.80 (23.6% Fib, just under the 20-day at 770.88). Staying above it keeps the path open to retest the record at 781.62.
  • Earnings within 7 days (watch for IV crush, the drop in option prices after a report):
    • TSLA reported after the close: EPS of $0.48 beat the ~$0.45 estimate, and the stock was roughly flat to slightly up after hours. Option premiums will reset lower tomorrow. TSLA is also the one ticker where put setups have shown an edge in your tests.
    • NOW reports Oct 28, the same day as the FOMC decision.
    • Just outside the window: XOM ~Oct 30; AAPL and PLTR ~Nov 2 (estimated dates).

5. Tomorrow (Thu Oct 22)

  • Data: 8:30 a.m. ET initial jobless claims (forecast 200K, previous 199K). Friday brings the S&P Global PMIs and Michigan inflation expectations.
  • Fed: no scheduled speeches on the Fed calendar. The FOMC meets Oct 27–28 (decision Wednesday at 2:00 p.m., press conference 2:30 p.m.).
  • Earnings before the open: P&G, Honeywell, Lockheed Martin, Union Pacific, Blackstone, Comcast, Valero, American Airlines.
  • Earnings after the close: Western Digital, Newmont, Deckers, Bloom Energy.
  • Also watch: Meta's after-hours jump (about +6%), any update on a Tesla–SpaceX merger, and Gulf oil headlines.
